input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: free affiliate/successor assignment for us (24.1), Vendor assignment (including by change of control) requires our consent and never to a competitor (24.2), and 24.4 bars any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing or fee acceleration on our change of control. 13.3 carries licence rights across a permitted assignment.

input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: we retain all rights in Customer Data and our pre-existing IP (14.1), own Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment (14.2), Vendor keeps only Vendor Technology with the perpetual paid-up licence back under 13.2 (14.3), and no joint ownership arises absent a separate signed instrument (14.4). 15.1 also bars model training on our data without consent. Ownership is conditioned on payment of the applicable Fees, which we note but do not treat as a deviation.

input.quote: Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: the grant expressly covers Affiliates and contractors worldwide (13.1), delivered/paid-up material carries a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence (13.2), and revocation or suspension is limited to a material uncured breach after notice and cure, with transferability to an Affiliate or successor (13.3). The use restrictions in 13.4 are narrow and expressly preserve our use of Customer Data and output.
